rows.note: This is the all-purpose reflexive choice when the antecedent is clear from context.

example.english: When they fell, they had to get themselves back up.
example.traditional: 佢哋跌低咗，要自己爬返起身。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 dit3 dai1 zo2 jiu3 zi6 gei2 paa4 faan1 hei2 san1

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that the plural group, rather than someone else, is involved.

example.english: They carried those boxes themselves, so they didn't need our help.
example.traditional: 嗰幾箱貨係佢哋自己搬嘅，唔使我哋幫手。
example.jyutping: go2 gei2 soeng1 fo3 hai6 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 bun1 ge3 m4 sai2 ngo5 dei6 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this only for the emphatic sense meaning that the person or group did something personally, not for an object reflexive.

example.english: The board members themselves came down to help.
example.jyutping: baan1 dung2 si6 can1 zi6 lok6 coeng4 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this when the singular they antecedent needs to be made explicit.

example.english: That customer hurt their hand and bandaged themselves.
example.traditional: 嗰個客整親隻手，佢自己包紮。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 haak3 zing2 can1 zek3 sau2 keoi5 zi6 gei2 baau1 zaat3
